raw.query: WITH owning AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.window_name, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, s.requests, s.requests_with_images, s.total_images, s.metrics, (s.metrics->'handoff_ms'->>'p50')::numeric AS p50_ms, (s.metrics->'handoff_ms'->>'max')::numeric AS max_ms, (s.metrics->>'handoff_gbps')::numeric AS gbps, (s.metrics->>'handoff_rtt_ms')::numeric AS rtt_ms, (s.metrics->'images_per_batch'->>'p50')::integer AS image_p50 FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.current_encoder_summary s USING(run_id) WHERE d.is_current=true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND d.run_id='sweeps:vision_head2k_s1'), projector AS (SELECT MIN(post_merge_tokens) AS tokens, MAX(post_merge_tokens) AS tokens_check, COUNT(*) AS backing_rows FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid=true AND image_px=448 AND n_images=1 AND post_merge_tokens IS NOT NULL), candidates AS (SELECT o.*, p.*, w.width, n.max_images FROM owning o CROSS JOIN projector p CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1,20000) w(width) CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1,1000) n(max_images) WHERE ROUND((o.rtt_ms + o.image_p50::numeric*p.tokens*w.width*2*8/o.gbps/1000000),3)=o.p50_ms AND ROUND((o.rtt_ms + n.max_images::numeric*p.tokens*w.width*2*8/o.gbps/1000000),2)=o.max_ms) SELECT run_id, window_name, is_current, superseded_by, requests AS denominator_requests, requests_with_images AS denominator_image_requests, total_images, backing_rows, tokens AS post_merge_tokens_per_image, tokens_check, image_p50, gbps, rtt_ms, p50_ms AS stored_p50_ms, max_ms AS stored_max_ms, COUNT(*) AS joint_candidate_count, MIN(width) AS inferred_width_min, MAX(width) AS inferred_width_max, MIN(max_images) AS inferred_max_images_min, MAX(max_images) AS inferred_max_images_max, MIN(tokens*width::numeric*2) AS bytes_per_image_min, MAX(tokens*width::numeric*2) AS bytes_per_image_max FROM candidates GROUP BY run_id, window_name, is_current, superseded_by, requests, requests_with_images, total_images, backing_rows, tokens, tokens_check, image_p50, gbps, rtt_ms, p50_ms, max_ms
raw.observed: Current, unsuperseded run sweeps:vision_head2k_s1: 2000 requests, 1263 image requests, 5758 images; 196 post-merge tokens/image, uniquely consistent with width 4096, 1605632 bytes/image, median image count 1, maximum 121, 25.0 Gbps, 0.2 ms RTT, handoff p50 0.714 ms and max 62.37 ms.
